name: recordAttempt
description: Log one learner turn you have judged, including hint repetitions. This is what the end-of-session debrief is built from, so call it for every turn that carried a real attempt.

beatId.description: The beat this attempt belongs to.

expected.description: What you were hoping for, or the model answer if this was a hint repetition.

verdict.description: One of: 'answered' (unaided, acceptable), 'repeated' (repeated the hint acceptably), 'partial' (close but flawed), 'missed' (failed after the allowed attempts).

correction.description: The corrected form, or an empty string if nothing needed correcting.
